Question: For the game show Who Wants To Be a Millionaire? the dollar values of each question are shown in the following table (where \(\text{K}=1000\)). \[ \begin{array}{ccccc} \boldsymbol{\#} & 1 & 2 & 3 \\ \boldsymbol{\$} & 100 & 200 & 300 \end{array} \]\[ \begin{array}{cccccc} 4 & 5 & 6 & 7 & 8 \\ 500 & 1\text{K} & 2\text{K} & 4\text{K} & 8\text{K} \end{array} \] \[ \begin{array}{ccccc} 9 & 10 & 11 & 12 \\ 16\text{K} & 32\text{K} & 64\text{K} & 125\text{K} \end{array} \] \[ \begin{array}{ccc} 13 & 14 & 15 \\ 250\text{K} & 500\text{K} & 1000\text{K} \end{array} \] Between which two questions is the percent increase of the value the smallest?
